title: [multiasic][database]database.sh failed to create the database for namespace in multiasic platform
author: mlok-nokia
body:
#### Description
database.sh failed to create the database for namespace in multiasic platform.
The latest code Docker version 20.10.x, command "docker create" no longer takes optional "NET=" with empty value. Syntax error show with current docker create command in database.sh.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. login in to the multiasic platform
2. execute command "docker ps -a" and check output
3. database (such as database0, database1...) containers for namespace are not shown in the output of the "docker ps -a" command
4. Also the following error messages in the syslog file
```
docker: no name set for network.
See 'docker create --help'.
Failed to docker run
``` 
#### Describe the results you received:
database (such as database0, database1...) containers for namespace are not created
Also the following error messages in the syslog file
```
docker: no name set for network.
See 'docker create --help'.
Failed to docker run
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
database containers for namespace should be created

#### Why I did it
database.sh failed to create the database for namespace in multiasic platform.
The latest code Docker version 20.10.x, command "docker create" no longer takes optional  "NET=" with empty value. Syntax error show with current docker create command in database.sh.  Issue #9503

#### How I did it
Modify the docker_image_ctl.j2 to set default network setting  NET="bridge" instead of empty for namespace database.  

#### How to verify it
boot up the new image in a multiasic platform.  the namespace database containers should be created.  Also the following error message should not be seen in syslog file
``` 
docker: no name set for network.
See 'docker create --help'.
Failed to docker run
```
